| If opponent's starship {{Errata hl|1=has just begun}} to move through hyperspace, draw destiny. If destiny &gt; pilot's ability, starship {{Errata hl|1=must return to original location and}} may not move this turn. If destiny = pilot's ability, starship is lost. || If opponent's starship {{Errata hl|1=is about}} to move through hyperspace, {{Errata hl|1=target that starship and its highest-ability pilot.}} Draw destiny. If destiny &gt; pilot's ability, starship may not move this turn. If destiny = pilot's ability, starship is lost.
